newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures end steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures end steady in thin trade.

text.p: Rubber futures finished mostly steady on Thursday in thin, lacklustre trade with the market seen drifting ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
"Trading was slack all day long. It's really all so flat. the volumes done were fairly small and the market may well drift ahead of the weekend," a local rubber trader said.
Traders said similarly flat trading in Japan contributed to the dull mood in the market.
Prices of Tokyo's benchmark April contract settled 0.2 yen up at 143.3 while Kobe's April contract was unchanged from yesterday's close of 142.7 yen.
"The only action in the market was provided by some European shortcovering for forward TSR20 rubber of about 120 tonnes," a dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, December RSS3 was seen at 125.00-126.00 U.S. cents a kg from 125.75 cents.
January RSS1 was seen at 183.00-185.00 Singapore cents (US$1.31-$1.32) a kg from the previous 183.50 cents.
January TSR20 was seen at 176.00-178.00 Singapore cents (US$1.25-$1.27) a kg from 177.00 cents.
